target: home team wins (ties excluded, playoffs included)
cutoff: 24 hours before scheduled kickoff. A finished game counts only if it kicked off at least 28 hours before the target kickoff.
reconstructed: Backtests are reconstructed from today's nflverse files, not from forecasts recorded before kickoff. nflverse EPA models were fitted with later data, so EPA-based features carry a small amount of hindsight.
qb_assumption: Projected quarterback = the team's primary passer in its previous game. An assumption, not confirmed starters.
not_used: the target game's own score, box score or starter
anything from the coverage or highlights modules

selection.rule: lowest pooled walk-forward log loss on 2012-2022 for each model family; blend weight from the same development predictions
selection.note: The winning configuration was picked from many on the same development games, so its development score is optimistic.

labels.blend: Blend of the two v2 models

features.rest_diff: Home minus away days of rest
features.home_short_week: Home team on 5 or fewer days of rest
features.away_short_week: Away team on 5 or fewer days of rest
features.home_off_bye: Home team coming off a bye (13+ days)
features.away_off_bye: Away team coming off a bye (13+ days)
features.form_diff: Home minus away average point margin, last 8 games
features.win_pct_diff: Home minus away win share this season
features.d_off_epa_w4: Offense: expected points added per play (home minus away)
features.d_def_off_epa_w4: Defense: expected points allowed per play (home minus away)
features.d_pass_epa_w4: Offense: expected points added per dropback (home minus away)
features.d_def_pass_epa_w4: Defense: expected points allowed per dropback (home minus away)
features.d_rush_epa_w4: Offense: expected points added per rush (home minus away)
features.d_def_rush_epa_w4: Defense: expected points allowed per rush (home minus away)
features.d_def_success_w4: Defense: success rate allowed (home minus away)
features.d_sack_rate_w4: Offense: sacks taken per dropback (home minus away)
features.d_def_sack_rate_w4: Defense: sacks made per dropback (home minus away)
features.d_turnover_rate_w4: Offense: giveaways per play (home minus away)
features.d_def_turnover_rate_w4: Defense: takeaways per play (home minus away)
features.d_explosive_w4: Offense: explosive-play rate (20+ yard pass, 10+ yard rush) (home minus away)
features.d_def_explosive_w4: Defense: explosive-play rate allowed (home minus away)
features.d_qb_epa_shrunk: Projected quarterbacks: expected points added per dropback over each one's last 8 starts, pulled toward the league average when he has few dropbacks
features.d_qb_log_dropbacks: Projected quarterbacks: difference in recent experience (log dropbacks, last 8 starts)

previously_examined_benchmark.note: These seasons were scored during v1. The v2 choice was frozen on 2012-2022 before this comparison, but this is not a fresh test.

closing_market_reference.note: De-vigged closing moneylines from the schedule file. Closing prices include information from after the 24-hour cutoff, so this is a later-information reference, not a baseline.
